Root.description:
Groups all parts of the drawer.
Doesn't render its own HTML element.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the drawer is initially open. To render a controlled drawer, use the `open` prop instead.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the drawer is currently open.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Event handler called when the drawer is opened or closed.

props.name: snapPoints
props.description:
Snap points used to position the drawer.
Use numbers between 0 and 1 to represent fractions of the viewport height,
numbers greater than 1 as pixel values, or strings in `px`/`rem` units
(for example, `'148px'` or `'30rem'`).

props.name: defaultSnapPoint
props.description: The initial snap point value when uncontrolled.

props.name: snapPoint
props.description: The currently active snap point. Use with `onSnapPointChange` to control the snap point.

props.name: onSnapPointChange
props.description: Callback fired when the snap point changes.

props.name: actionsRef
props.description:
A callback that receives the imperative actions. It's called once, when the component is set up (like a `ref` callback). `unmount`: Ends the closing phase of the drawer after an externally controlled closing animation finishes.
Call `preventUnmountOnClose()` in `onOpenChange` first, otherwise the drawer completes closing on its own.
Whether it leaves the DOM is decided by `keepMounted` on the portal.`close`: Closes the drawer imperatively when called.

props.name: defaultTriggerId
props.description:
ID of the trigger that the drawer is associated with.
This is useful in conjunction with the `defaultOpen` prop to create an initially open drawer.

props.name: disablePointerDismissal
props.description:
Whether to prevent the drawer from closing on outside presses.
For non-modal drawers, this also prevents the drawer from closing when focus moves outside of it.

props.name: handle
props.description:
A handle to associate the drawer with a trigger.
If specified, allows detached triggers to control the drawer's open state.
Can be created with the Drawer.createHandle() method.

props.name: modal
props.description: Determines if the drawer enters a modal state when open. `true`: user interaction is limited to just the drawer: focus is trapped, document page scroll is locked, and pointer interactions on outside elements are disabled.`false`: user interaction with the rest of the document is allowed.`'trap-focus'`: focus is trapped inside the drawer, but document page scroll is not locked and pointer interactions outside of it remain enabled.

props.name: onOpenChangeComplete
props.description: Event handler called after any animations complete when the drawer is opened or closed.

props.name: snapToSequentialPoints
props.description: Disables velocity-based snap skipping so drag distance determines the next snap point.

props.name: swipeDirection
props.description: The swipe direction used to dismiss the drawer.

props.name: triggerId
props.description:
ID of the trigger that the drawer is associated with.
This is useful in conjunction with the `open` prop to create a controlled drawer.
There's no need to specify this prop when the drawer is uncontrolled (that is, when the `open` prop is not set).

props.name: children
props.description: The content of the drawer.

additionalTypes.source: type DrawerRootActions = { unmount: () => void; close: () => void };

Doesn't render its own HTML element.

A container for the drawer contents.
Renders a `<div>` element.

props.name: initialFocus
props.type: boolean | HTMLElement | null | ((openType: InteractionType) => boolean | void | HTMLElement | null)
props.description:
Determines the element to focus when the drawer is opened. `false`: Do not move focus.`true`: Move focus based on the default behavior (first tabbable element or popup).`HTMLElement`: Move focus to the element. `null` (an element that isn't set yet) falls back to the default behavior.`function`: Called with the interaction type (`mouse`, `touch`, `pen`, or `keyboard`).
Return an element to focus, `true` to use the default behavior, or `false`/`undefined` to do nothing.

props.name: finalFocus
props.type: boolean | HTMLElement | null | ((closeType: InteractionType) => boolean | void | HTMLElement | null)
props.description:
Determines the element to focus when the drawer is closed. `false`: Do not move focus.`true`: Move focus based on the default behavior (trigger or previously focused element).`HTMLElement`: Move focus to the element. `null` (an element that isn't set yet) falls back to the default behavior.`function`: Called with the interaction type (`mouse`, `touch`, `pen`, or `keyboard`).
Return an element to focus, `true` to use the default behavior, or `false`/`undefined` to do nothing.

VirtualKeyboardProvider.description: Provides keyboard-aware focus and scroll handling for bottom-sheet drawers with form fields.

createHandle.description: Creates a new handle to connect a Drawer.Root with detached Drawer.Trigger components.

Handle.description:
Controls a Drawer imperatively and associates detached `Drawer.Trigger` components with a
`Drawer.Root`. Create one with `Drawer.createHandle()` and pass it to the `handle` prop of the
root and of any triggers rendered outside of it.

The imperative methods take effect only while a root using this handle is mounted; calls made
before a root attaches (or after it unmounts) are ignored.
